profiles.mask_convention: bit i is physical mode i; one is a click
profiles.step_cache_scope: one conditional; ordered physical subsets; no cross-step reuse
profiles.enumerated_law: product of computed conditional probabilities under ideal continuous uniforms; not a finite PRNG-state enumeration
profiles.profiling_notes: Selection inclusive contains selection event time; use overhead plus event for nonoverlapping totals. Scratch-cache preparation is separate; loop/output work is unclassified. Timers run only with --profile.
